notes: ACCESS: r.jina.ai - the route that worked in the prior Home-Decor pass - now returns a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' 403 for every pbteen URL, so it was abandoned. Two other routes worked. (a) curl_cffi with an iOS Safari fingerprint: safari17_2_ios / safari18_0_ios / safari15_5 return the full 600-700KB SSR document on /shop/ paths where every desktop profile (chrome110-131, edge101, firefox133, safari18_0 desktop) gets the Akamai 'PBteen: 403 - Restricted Access' page. The WAF is flaky, so a random-profile retry loop was used. robots.txt is served to any profile and names no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web directive (only EasouSpider is disallowed), so no Claude-specific block applies. (b) Chrome via claude-in-chrome, to render each listing page and read the site's own product-count element. TREE: taken from the site's own mega-menu flyouts, parsed out of the SSR HTML of /shop/furniture/, /shop/study/, /shop/storage/ and /shop/bath/, and cross-checked against https://www.pbteen.com/netstorage/sitemaps/shop-sitemap-1.xml.gz (610 shop URLs). The Furniture department has exactly four groups - Bedroom Furniture, Study Furniture, Lounge Furniture, Storage Furniture - and each of those four parent slugs (bedroom-furniture, desk-study-furniture, lounge-furniture, storage-furniture) returns 0 products in the site's own search engine, confirming they are navigation-only pages; they are emitted as grouping rows. QTY: every leaf number is the rendered listing header on the loaded page. PB Teen shows either 'N Items' under the H1 or the 'View N Items' jump-link variant (classes product-count-message-jump-link / product-count-jump-link-container); the literal string is quoted in each row's evidence. As an independent second check, every leaf was also queried against the storefront's own Constructor.io browse endpoint (ac.cnstrc.com/browse/group_id/<slug>, key key_QdCsKhJzRGmFMX0N read from __INITIAL_STATE__.searchEngineConfig.constructorKey): total_num_results matched the rendered header on 17 of 17 leaves, so no Constructor inflation was observed on PB Teen today - but no Constructor figure was used as a qty on its own. Page titles were checked on every load to confirm the slug served the category it claims (no silent parent fallback), and counts were read twice per page. EXCLUDED and why: Mattresses (/shop/furniture/mattress-basics/, 23 items) - bedding, not furniture, per the brief. Bedroom Collections, Lounge Seating Collections, Storage Collections and Study Furniture Collections - marketing collection roll-ups. All Bedroom Furniture, All Study Furniture, All Lounge Furniture, All Storage Furniture, Shop All Furniture, All In-Stock & Quick Ship Furniture, Best Selling Furniture, New Arrivals, Contract Grade, the GREENGUARD / FSC / Accessible Collection feature shops and every Sale node - aggregate, promotional or landing pages. The Storage menu's 'Desk Systems' entry is a multi-facet URL (/shop/furniture/desk---bookcase-set+storage-desk+...), a filter page rather than a category. The whole Dorm department (/shop/dorm/ - dorm-headboards-furniture, lounge-chairs, sleeper-sofas-and-sectionals, desk-chairs-teen-dorm, storage-ottomans-and-stools, bookcases, trunks-and-side-tables) was excluded: it is a parallel room / sub-brand shop whose assortment is a re-cut of the same furniture catalogue, and inside the Furniture mega-menu it is represented only by an 'All Dorm Furniture' roll-up. Storage Carts (/shop/storage/storage-carts/, 56) was excluded because PB Teen itself files it under Storage Accessories, not Storage Furniture. The Storage department's 'Storage Furniture' group links only to slugs already captured here (storage-beds, furniture-dressers-armoires, modular-storage-cabinets, bookcases-shelves, vanity-furniture, media-storage), so it adds no rows. /shop/furniture/gaming-chairs/ exists in the sitemap (7 products) but is not in the site's navigation - the nav's 'Gaming Chairs & Tables' entry points at /shop/furniture/game-tables/ - so it was not emitted as a separate leaf. /shop/seating/ and /shop/furniture/dorm-furniture-category/ return 0 products (empty landing shells). ABSENCE CHECKS: Bath was inspected node by node and PB Teen sells no bathroom furniture (no vanity units or bathroom cabinets) - only towels, shower curtains, caddies, bathroom mirrors and organisation. Decor, Bedding, Rugs, Windows, Lighting, Gifts and Backpacks & Lunch carry no furniture-typed children. There is no outdoor/patio, dining or office department on this site.
